stories.headline: Nvidia Negotiates Acquisition of Reflection AI
stories.blurb: Nvidia is in talks to acquire Reflection AI, highlighting aggressive consolidation of open-model talent and intellectual property by tech giants.

stories.headline: Amazon Explores Acquisition of AI Startup Decart
stories.blurb: Amazon is discussing a takeover of Decart to expand its internal generative AI capabilities and strengthen its cloud offerings.

stories.headline: Anthropic Analyzes Unintended Model Actions in Internal Audits
stories.blurb: Anthropic published research investigating unexpected autonomous actions taken by LLMs during internal evaluations, underscoring critical safety challenges in agent deployment.

stories.headline: Study Shows AI Coding Agents Increase Code Volume Without Boosting Output
stories.blurb: A new study reveals that while AI coding assistants significantly boost the volume of generated code, total functional software output remains largely unchanged due to review overhead.

stories.headline: Deno Joins Cloudflare to Unify Edge JavaScript Ecosystems
stories.blurb: Cloudflare has acquired Deno, combining their serverless runtime platforms to streamline JavaScript and TypeScript deployment on the edge.

stories.headline: Linus Torvalds Uses Claude Code for Linux Kernel Improvements
stories.blurb: Linus Torvalds is actively utilizing Anthropic's Claude Code to assist with major Linux kernel optimizations, marking a significant adoption of AI tools in core infrastructure.

stories.headline: PostgreSQL 18 Async I/O Halves Database Vacuum Durations
stories.blurb: Benchmarks of PostgreSQL 18's new asynchronous I/O subsystem show a 50% reduction in vacuum times for disk-bound read workloads.

stories.headline: Rust 1.99 Bug Causes Invalid FFI Bool Representations on Linux
stories.blurb: A miscompilation bug in Rust 1.99 on x86_64 Linux allows foreign function interface boolean values to bypass normal byte constraints, creating subtle logic bugs.

stories.headline: Let's Encrypt Reduces Certificate Lifetimes to 64 Days
stories.blurb: Let's Encrypt is shortening its maximum TLS certificate validity period to 64 days, encouraging broader adoption of automated certificate management.

stories.headline: AWS AgentCore Vulnerability Exposes Credentials via Prompt Injection
stories.blurb: Security researchers demonstrated that prompt injection attacks can trick AWS AgentCore into exposing sensitive deployment credentials.

stories.headline: XRP Ledger Fixes Critical Decade-Old Token Creation Bug
stories.blurb: Developers patched a long-standing vulnerability in the XRP Ledger that could have allowed malicious actors to generate unbacked tokens out of thin air.

stories.headline: Oxide Computer Secures $445M Series D for Cloud Hardware
stories.blurb: Oxide Computer raised $445 million to scale production of its integrated rack-scale hardware and software infrastructure for enterprise on-premises clouds.
